scripts.setup: npm install --prefix apps/web && cd backend && uv sync
scripts.infra: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.seed:reset: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed --reset
scripts.dev:api: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8010
scripts.dev: npm run infra && npm run migrate && npm run seed && (npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web & wait)
